instruction: A spherical kinetic sculpture of interlocking brass gears, cogs and rings forming a hollow orb, with a small polished core at the center. Aged brass and copper metals, machined teeth, steampunk clockwork.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE clockwork gear orb in a brass clockwork kinetic sculpture style. A spherical kinetic sculpture of interlocking brass gears, cogs and rings forming a hollow orb, with a small polished core at the center. Aged brass and copper metals, machined teeth, steampunk clockwork. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
